messages.content:
Reviewing the contract against the inspected `subject.mjs`:

- "At most twelve complete exchanges" — validated by `history.length <= 12` plus the tool-pair checks. ✔
- "Call IDs must be nonempty strings and unique within each exchange" — present. ✔
- "Every result role is tool and ID matches the positional call" — the current code only checks `ids.includes(message.tool_call_id)`, not that each result matches the *positional* call at `ids[index]`. This is the contract deviation to restore.
- "Masking affects old content only; original journal bytes remain external" — masking applies only to entries before the recent window, returning other entries unchanged. ✔

I'll tighten the result-message check to require positional ID agreement, preserving all other behavior byte-for-byte.
